description: This file provides shell support scripts for integrating Git repository status into Bash and Zsh prompts. It includes functions to detect repository state, compare branches, and format status indicators for user prompts.

methods.name: __git_ps1
methods.description: Main function to generate and set the Git status string in the prompt, supporting various shell configurations and options.

methods.name: __git_ps1_show_upstream
methods.description: Helper to determine the divergence between local branch and upstream.

methods.name: __git_ps1_colorize_gitstring
methods.description: Applies color formatting to parts of the Git status string for enhanced prompt visibility.

methods.name: __git_sequencer_status
methods.description: Checks ongoing Git operations like cherry-pick, rebase, or merge to reflect their status in the prompt.

methods.name: __git_eread
methods.description: Reads the first line of a file into a variable if it is readable.
